content_fields.title: Verify query-level access control is implemented
content_fields.description: Verify that access control is enforced at the query level in the database.
content_fields.guidance: Verification means confirming the database enforces per-row or per-view restrictions independently of the application, by connecting as a restricted role and observing that it cannot read rows outside its scope.
content_fields.found: All access uses one privileged database account; no row-level security policies or restricted views are defined in the migrations.
content_fields.missing: Database roles, row-level security policies and the migration that would create them.
content_fields.conclusion: Query-level access control is configured in the database server; there is no policy in this repository to verify.
content_fields.action: The database administration team should define and verify query-level access controls.
